theorem find?_filter' {α} (l : List α) (p q : α → Bool) :
    (l.filter p).find? q = l.find? (fun a => p a && q a) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => by_cases hp : p x <;> by_cases hq : q x <;> simp [hp, hq, ih]

/-- A search loop returning the index of the first match, read as the match. -/
def idxAbs {α} (l : List α) : core.result.Result Usize Error → Option (Option α)
  | .Ok i => if h : i.val < l.length then some (some l[i.val]) else none
  | .Err _ => some none

theorem idx_ok {α} {l : List α} {P : α → Bool} {i : Usize}
    (h : idxAbs l (.Ok i) = ((l.find? P).map (fun x => some (some x))).getD (some none)) :
    ∃ hi : i.val < l.length, l.find? P = some l[i.val] := by
  simp only [idxAbs] at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hi
    refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
    cases hf : l.find? P <;> simp_all
  · cases hf : l.find? P <;> simp_all

theorem idx_err {α} {l : List α} {P : α → Bool} {e : Error}
    (h : idxAbs l (.Err e) = ((l.find? P).map (fun x => some (some x))).getD (some none)) :
    l.find? P = none := by
  simp only [idxAbs] at h
  cases hf : l.find? P <;> simp_all

@[step] theorem kind_eq_spec (a b : Kind) : kind_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  unfold kind_eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp

@[step] theorem has_row_spec (rows : Slice UserRoom) (u r : U64) :
    svc_cache.has_row rows u r ⦃ b => b = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ rows.val, x.user = u ∧ x.room = r ⦄ := by

  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search rows.val (fun x => decide (x.user = u ∧ x.room = r)) (fun b : Bool => b)

  · intro b hb
    rw [hb, searchFrom_const]
    simp
  · intro j hj; unfold svc_cache.has_row_loop.body; i5h_step

def stOf (x : Room) : core.result.Result U64 Error :=
  match x.state with
  | .None => .Err .NotFound
  | .Hash h => .Ok h

  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.rooms.val (fun x => decide (x.id = room)) (fun r => r)

    rw [hr, searchFrom_findD]; simp

  | .Err _ => none

theorem get_pdu_ok (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) (i : Usize)
    (h : svc_timeline.get_pdu s e = ok (.Ok i)) :
    ∃ hi : i.val < s.pdus.val.length, eventOf s e.val = some s.pdus.val[i.val] := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hn := post_of_ok (get_non_outlier_spec s e) hr
  cases r with
  | Ok j =>
    simp only [ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h
    subst h
    obtain ⟨hi, hf⟩ := idx_ok hn
    refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
    unfold eventOf timeline
    rw [find?_filter']
    have : (fun p : Pdu => !p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = e.val)) =
        (fun p => !p.outlier && decide (p.event_id = e)) := by funext p; simp [u64_val_eq]
    rw [this, hf]
  | Err _ =>
    simp only at h
    have hf0 := idx_err hn
    have ho := post_of_ok (get_outlier_spec s e) h
    obtain ⟨hi, hf⟩ := idx_ok ho
    refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
    unfold eventOf timeline
    rw [find?_filter', find?_filter']
    have h1 : (fun p : Pdu => !p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = e.val)) =
        (fun p => !p.outlier && decide (p.event_id = e)) := by funext p; simp [u64_val_eq]
    have h2 : (fun p : Pdu => p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = e.val)) =
        (fun p => p.outlier && decide (p.event_id = e)) := by funext p; simp [u64_val_eq]
    rw [h1, hf0, h2, hf]

theorem vec_index_ok {α} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize) (x : α)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok x) :
    ∃ hi : i.val < v.val.length, x = v.val[i.val] := by
  rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i y hy
    simp only [ok.injEq] at h
    subst h
    have := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := this
    exact ⟨hi, he.symm⟩

theorem state_get_id_ok (s : Snapshot) (h : U64) (k : Kind) (key id : U64)
    (hr : svc_accessor.state_get_id s h k key = ok (.Ok id)) :
    ∃ es, stateEntries s h.val = some es ∧ ∃ en,
      es.find? (fun en => en.kind = k ∧ en.state_key.val = key.val) = some en ∧ en.event_id = id := by
  unfold svc_accessor.state_get_id at hr
  obtain ⟨r, hl, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  have hn := post_of_ok (load_full_state_spec s h) hl
  cases r with
  | Ok si =>
    simp only at hr
    obtain ⟨hi, hf⟩ := idx_ok hn
    obtain ⟨ss, hx, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    obtain ⟨_, hss⟩ := vec_index_ok _ _ _ hx
    have he := post_of_ok (find_entry_spec _ k key) hr
    simp only [entAbs] at he
    refine ⟨ss.entries.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold stateEntries
      have : (fun x : StateSet => decide (x.hash.val = h.val)) = (fun x => decide (x.hash = h)) := by
        funext x; simp [u64_val_eq]
      rw [this, hf, hss]; rfl
    · cases hfe : List.find? (fun en => decide (en.kind = k ∧ en.state_key = key)) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ss.entries).val with
      | none => rw [hfe] at he; simp at he
      | some en =>
        rw [hfe] at he
        simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at he
        refine ⟨en, ?_, he.symm⟩
        have : (fun en : StateEntry => decide (en.kind = k ∧ en.state_key.val = key.val)) =
            (fun en => decide (en.kind = k ∧ en.state_key = key)) := by
          funext x; simp [u64_val_eq]
        rw [this]; simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Slice.from_val] using hfe
  | Err _ => simp at hr

theorem state_get_ok (s : Snapshot) (h : U64) (k : Kind) (key : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hr : svc_accessor.state_get s h k key = ok (.Ok i)) :
    ∃ hi : i.val < s.pdus.val.length, stateLookup s h.val k key.val = some s.pdus.val[i.val] := by
  unfold svc_accessor.state_get at hr
  obtain ⟨r, hl, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  cases r with
  | Ok id =>
    simp only at hr
    obtain ⟨es, hes, en, hen, hid⟩ := state_get_id_ok s h k key id hl
    obtain ⟨hi, hev⟩ := get_pdu_ok s id i hr
    refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
    unfold stateLookup
    rw [hes]; simp only
    rw [hen]; simp only
    rw [hid, hev]
  | Err _ => simp at hr

theorem room_state_get_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (k : Kind) (key : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hr : svc_accessor.room_state_get s room k key = ok (.Ok i)) :
    ∃ h, roomState s room.val = some h.val ∧ svc_accessor.state_get s h k key = ok (.Ok i) := by
  unfold svc_accessor.room_state_get at hr
  obtain ⟨r, hl, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  have hn := post_of_ok (get_room_shortstatehash_spec s room) hl
  cases r with
  | Ok h =>
    refine ⟨h, ?_, hr⟩
    unfold roomState
    have : (fun x : Room => decide (x.id.val = room.val)) = (fun x => decide (x.id = room)) := by
      funext x; simp [u64_val_eq]
    rw [this]
    cases hf : List.find? (fun x => decide (x.id = room)) s.rooms.val with
    | none => rw [hf] at hn; simp at hn
    | some x =>
      rw [hf] at hn
      obtain ⟨_, _, st⟩ := x
      cases st <;> simp_all [stOf]
  | Err _ => simp at hr

theorem room_history_visibility_wr (s : Snapshot) (room : U64)
    (hr : svc_accessor.room_history_visibility s room = ok (some .WorldReadable)) :
    WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.room_history_visibility at hr
  obtain ⟨r, hl, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  cases r with
  | Ok i =>
    simp only at hr
    obtain ⟨p, hx, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    obtain ⟨_, hp⟩ := vec_index_ok _ _ _ hx
    obtain ⟨h, hrs, hsg⟩ := room_state_get_ok s room _ _ i hl
    obtain ⟨_, hsl⟩ := state_get_ok s h _ _ i hsg
    refine ⟨h.val, hrs, p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hp]; exact hsl
    · cases hv : p.history_visibility <;> rw [hv] at hr <;> simp_all
  | Err _ => simp at hr

theorem has_row_ok (v : alloc.vec.Vec UserRoom) (u r : U64)
    (h : svc_cache.has_row (alloc.vec.Vec.deref v) u r = ok true) :
    ∃ x ∈ v.val, x.user.val = u.val ∧ x.room.val = r.val := by
  have := (post_of_ok (has_row_spec _ u r) h).1 rfl
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Slice.from_val] at this
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hu, hr⟩ := this
  exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [hu], by rw [hr]⟩

theorem user_can_see_state_events_ok (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64)
    (hr : svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s u room = ok true) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ Invited s u.val room.val ∨ OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∨
      WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events at hr
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
  cases b with
  | true => exact Or.inl (has_row_ok _ _ _ hb)
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hr
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hr⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
    cases o with
    | none =>
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hhv; subst hhv
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (has_row_ok _ _ _ hr)))
    | some v =>
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hhv; subst hhv
      cases v with
      | WorldReadable => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (room_history_visibility_wr s room ho)))
      | Shared => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (has_row_ok _ _ _ hr)))
      | Invited => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (has_row_ok _ _ _ hr))
      | Joined => simp at hr
      | Custom _ => simp at hr

theorem state_reads_need_membership (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (op : Op) (r : Reply)
    (hop : op = .State room ∨ (∃ k key, op = .StateEvent room k key) ∨ ∃ at_ m n, op = .Members room at_ m n)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, op⟩ = ok (.Ok r)) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ Invited s u.val room.val ∨ OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∨ WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  apply user_can_see_state_events_ok
  rcases hop with rfl | ⟨k, key, rfl⟩ | ⟨at_, m, n, rfl⟩ <;> simp only [transition] at h
  · unfold api_state.get_state_events_route at h
    obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    cases b
    · simp at h
    · exact hb
  · unfold api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route at h
    obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    cases b
    · simp at h
    · exact hb
  · unfold api_members.get_member_events_route at h
    obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    cases b
    · simp at h
    · exact hb

theorem find_entry_hv_spec (entries : Slice StateEntry) :
    svc_accessor.find_entry entries .HistoryVisibility 0#u64 ⦃ res =>
      (match res with | .Ok id => some id.val | .Err _ => none) =
        (entries.val.find? (fun en => en.kind = .HistoryVisibility ∧ en.state_key.val = 0)).map (·.event_id.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.find_entry svc_accessor.find_entry_loop

    (fun en => decide (en.kind = .HistoryVisibility ∧ en.state_key = 0#u64))
    (fun res => match res with | .Ok id => some id.val | .Err _ => none)
    (fun _ en => some en.event_id.val)
    none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    rw [hr, searchFrom_find]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero]
    have h : (fun en : StateEntry => decide (en.kind = Kind.HistoryVisibility ∧ en.state_key = 0#u64)) =
        (fun en => decide (en.kind = Kind.HistoryVisibility ∧ en.state_key.val = 0)) := by
      funext en
      simp only [decide_eq_decide]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2 ▸ rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, (u64_val_eq _ _).1 (by rw [h2]; rfl)⟩
    rw [h]
  · intro j hj
    unfold svc_accessor.find_entry_loop.body

@[step] theorem get_non_outlier_spec (s : Snapshot) (event_id : U64) :
    svc_timeline.get_non_outlier s event_id ⦃ res =>
      (match res with | .Ok i => s.pdus.val[i.val]? | .Err _ => none) =
        (timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = event_id.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop timeline
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.pdus.val
    (fun p => decide (!p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id))
    (fun res => match res with | .Ok i => s.pdus.val[i.val]? | .Err _ => none)
    (fun _ p => some p)
    none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    rw [hr, searchFrom_find]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero]
    rw [find?_filter]
    have h : (fun (p : Pdu) => (!p.outlier) && decide (p.event_id.val = event_id.val)) =
        (fun (p : Pdu) => decide (!p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id)) := by
      funext p
      cases p.outlier <;> simp [u64_val_eq]
    rw [h]
    cases s.pdus.val.find? (fun (p : Pdu) => decide (!p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id)) <;> rfl
  · intro j hj
    unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop.body
    i5h_step

@[step] theorem get_outlier_spec (s : Snapshot) (event_id : U64) :
    svc_timeline.get_outlier s event_id ⦃ res =>
      (match res with | .Ok i => s.pdus.val[i.val]? | .Err _ => none) =
        (s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => p.outlier)).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = event_id.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_outlier svc_timeline.get_outlier_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.pdus.val
    (fun p => decide (p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id))
    (fun res => match res with | .Ok i => s.pdus.val[i.val]? | .Err _ => none)
    (fun _ p => some p)
    none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    rw [hr, searchFrom_find]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero]
    rw [find?_filter]
    have h : (fun (p : Pdu) => p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = event_id.val)) =
        (fun (p : Pdu) => decide (p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id)) := by
      funext p
      cases p.outlier <;> simp [u64_val_eq]
    rw [h]
    cases s.pdus.val.find? (fun (p : Pdu) => decide (p.outlier ∧ p.event_id = event_id)) <;> rfl
  · intro j hj
    unfold svc_timeline.get_outlier_loop.body
    i5h_step

theorem get_pdu_eq_ok (s : Snapshot) (id : U64) (i : Usize) (p : Pdu)
    (h : svc_timeline.get_pdu s id = ok (.Ok i))
    (hp : s.pdus.val[i.val]? = some p) :
    eventOf s id.val = some p := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hstep⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases r with
  | Ok j =>
    dsimp only at hstep
    rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hstep
    cases hstep
    have hspec := post_of_ok (get_non_outlier_spec s id) hr
    dsimp only at hspec
    rw [hp] at hspec
    unfold eventOf
    rw [← hspec]
  | Err e =>
    dsimp only at hstep
    have hspec1 := post_of_ok (get_non_outlier_spec s id) hr
    dsimp only at hspec1
    have hspec2 := post_of_ok (get_outlier_spec s id) hstep
    dsimp only at hspec2
    rw [hp] at hspec2
    unfold eventOf
    rw [← hspec1, ← hspec2]

theorem room_history_visibility_world_readable (s : Snapshot) (room : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.room_history_visibility s room = ok (some .WorldReadable)) :
    WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.room_history_visibility at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hstep⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases r with
  | Err e =>
    dsimp only at hstep
    rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hstep
    contradiction
  | Ok i =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp_idx, hmatch⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hstep
    have hp_get := vec_index_eq_ok s.pdus i p hp_idx
    cases hv : p.history_visibility with
    | Absent =>
      rw [hv] at hmatch
      dsimp only at hmatch
      rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hmatch
      contradiction
    | Is v =>
      rw [hv] at hmatch
      dsimp only at hmatch
      rw [Result.ok.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hmatch
      subst hmatch
      unfold svc_accessor.room_state_get at hr
      obtain ⟨r_hash, hr_hash, hr_step⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr
      cases r_hash with
      | Err e =>
        dsimp only at hr_step
        rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hr_step
        contradiction
      | Ok hash =>
        have hroom_spec := post_of_ok (get_room_shortstatehash_spec s room) hr_hash
        dsimp only at hroom_spec
        unfold svc_accessor.state_get at hr_step
        obtain ⟨r_id, hr_id, hr_id_step⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr_step
        cases r_id with
        | Err e =>
          dsimp only at hr_id_step
          rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hr_id_step
          contradiction
        | Ok id =>
          have hevent := get_pdu_eq_ok s id i p hr_id_step hp_get
          unfold svc_accessor.state_get_id at hr_id
          obtain ⟨r_state, hr_state, hr_state_step⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr_id
          cases r_state with
          | Err e =>
            dsimp only at hr_state_step
            rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hr_state_step
            contradiction
          | Ok si =>
            obtain ⟨ss, hss_idx, hfind⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hr_state_step
            have hss_get := vec_index_eq_ok s.states si ss hss_idx
            have hstate_spec := post_of_ok (load_full_state_spec s hash) hr_state
            dsimp only at hstate_spec
            rw [hss_get] at hstate_spec
            have hfind_spec := post_of_ok (find_entry_hv_spec (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ss.entries)) hfind
            rw [vec_deref_val] at hfind_spec
            unfold WorldReadableNow
            refine ⟨hash.val, hroom_spec.symm, p, ?_, hv⟩
            unfold stateLookup stateEntries
            rw [← hstate_spec]
            cases hfe : ss.entries.val.find? (fun en => en.kind = Kind.HistoryVisibility ∧ en.state_key.val = 0) with
            | none =>
              rw [hfe] at hfind_spec
              contradiction
            | some en =>
              rw [hfe] at hfind_spec
              dsimp only at hfind_spec
              have hid : id.val = en.event_id.val := Option.some.inj hfind_spec
              dsimp only [Option.map]
              rw [hfe]
              dsimp only
              rw [← hid]
              exact hevent

theorem has_row_spec (rows : Slice UserRoom) (user room : U64) :
    svc_cache.has_row rows user room ⦃ res =>
      (res = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ rows.val, x.user.val = user.val ∧ x.room.val = room.val) ⦄ := by

theorem user_can_see_state_events_ok_true (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s u room = ok true) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ Invited s u.val room.val ∨ OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∨ WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hrest⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases b with
  | true =>
    left
    exact is_joined_ok_true s u room hb
  | false =>
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hrest2⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest
    cases o with
    | none =>
      dsimp only at hrest2
      obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hrest3⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest2
      rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hhv
      cases hhv
      dsimp only at hrest3
      right; right; left
      exact once_joined_ok_true s u room hrest3
    | some v =>
      dsimp only at hrest2
      obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hrest3⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hrest2
      rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hhv

      | WorldReadable =>

        right; right; right
        exact room_history_visibility_world_readable s room ho
      | Shared =>
        dsimp only at hrest3
        right; right; left
        exact once_joined_ok_true s u room hrest3
      | Invited =>
        dsimp only at hrest3
        right; left
        exact is_invited_ok_true s u room hrest3
      | Joined =>
        dsimp only at hrest3
        rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hrest3
        contradiction
      | Custom _ =>
        dsimp only at hrest3
        rw [Result.ok.injEq] at hrest3
        contradiction

  · unfold transition at h

    obtain ⟨b, hb, hstep⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h

  · unfold transition at h

    obtain ⟨b, hb, hstep⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h

  · unfold transition at h

    obtain ⟨b, hb, hstep⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    cases b with

/-! ## Search models -/

theorem searchFrom_bind {α β : Type} (l : List α) (P : α → Bool) (f : α → Option β) (k : Nat) :
    searchFrom l P (fun _ x => f x) none k = ((l.drop k).find? P).bind f := by
  induction h : l.length - k generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_end (by omega), List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hk : k < l.length := by omega
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hk, List.find?_cons]
    by_cases hp : P l[k]
    · rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_found hk hp]; simp [hp]
    · rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_skip hk hp, ih (k + 1) (by omega)]; simp [hp]

theorem searchFrom_some_idx {α : Type} (l : List α) (P : α → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    searchFrom l P (fun i _ => some i) none k = ((l.drop k).findIdx? P).map (· + k) := by
  induction h : l.length - k generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_end (by omega), List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hk : k < l.length := by omega
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hk, List.findIdx?_cons]
    by_cases hp : P l[k]
    · rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_found hk hp]; simp [hp]
    · rw [I5hLib.searchFrom_skip hk hp, ih (k + 1) (by omega)]
      simp only [hp]
      cases (List.drop (k + 1) l).findIdx? P <;> simp <;> omega

theorem find?_eq_none_of_findIdx?_eq_none {α : Type} {l : List α} {P : α → Bool}
    (h : l.findIdx? P = none) : l.find? P = none := by
  rw [List.find?_eq_bind_findIdx?_getElem?, h]; rfl

theorem find?_eq_some_of_findIdx?_eq_some {α : Type} {l : List α} {P : α → Bool} {i : Nat}
    (h : l.findIdx? P = some i) : ∃ hh : i < l.length, l.find? P = some (l[i]'hh) := by
  have hlt : i < l.length := by
    rw [List.findIdx?_eq_some_iff_getElem] at h; exact h.choose
  refine ⟨hlt, ?_⟩
  rw [List.find?_eq_bind_findIdx?_getElem?, h]
  simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]

theorem Option_map_add_zero (o : Option Nat) : o.map (fun x => x + 0) = o := by
  cases o <;> rfl

theorem searchFrom_state_zero (l : List Room) (room : U64) :
    searchFrom l (fun x => decide (x.id = room))
      (fun _ x => match x.state with | .Hash h => some h.val | _ => none) none 0
    = match l.find? (fun x => decide (x.id = room)) with
      | some x => (match x.state with | .Hash h => some h.val | _ => none)
      | none => none := by
  rw [searchFrom_bind, List.drop_zero]
  cases h : l.find? (fun x => decide (x.id = room)) with
  | none => rfl
  | some x => rfl

theorem load_full_state_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) :

      s.pdus.val.findIdx? (nonOutlierMatch e)

  unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier
  refine WP.spec_mono (I5hLib.loop_search s.pdus.val (nonOutlierMatch e)
    (fun res => match res with | .Ok i => some i.val | .Err _ => none)
    (fun i _ => some i) none
    (fun i1 => svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop.body s e i1) ?_ 0#usize (by simp)) ?_
  · intro j hj
    unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop.body
    step*
    all_goals
      simp only [I5hLib.SearchStep]
      first
      | (left; exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by simp_all [nonOutlierMatch], by simp_all⟩)
      | (right; exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by simp_all [nonOutlierMatch]⟩)
      | (exact ⟨by scalar_tac, by simp_all [nonOutlierMatch]⟩)
  · intro y hy
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hy
    rw [searchFrom_some_idx, List.drop_zero, Option_map_add_zero] at hy
    exact hy.symm

/-! ## Timeline event resolution -/

theorem eventOf_eq_some_of_timeline {s : Snapshot} {e : Nat} {p : Pdu}
    (h : (timeline s).find? (fun q => decide (q.event_id.val = e)) = some p) :
    eventOf s e = some p := by
  unfold eventOf
  rw [h]

theorem eventOf_eq_some_of_outlier {s : Snapshot} {e : Nat} {p : Pdu}
    (h1 : (timeline s).find? (fun q => decide (q.event_id.val = e)) = none)
    (h2 : (s.pdus.val.filter (fun q => q.outlier)).find? (fun q => decide (q.event_id.val = e)) = some p) :
    eventOf s e = some p := by
  unfold eventOf
  rw [h1, h2]

theorem nonOutlierMatch_eq (e : U64) (p : Pdu) :
    nonOutlierMatch e p = (!p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = e.val)) := by
  by_cases h1 : p.outlier <;> by_cases h2 : p.event_id = e <;>
    simp [nonOutlierMatch, h1, h2, u64_val_eq]

theorem outlierMatch_eq (e : U64) (p : Pdu) :
    outlierMatch e p = (p.outlier && decide (p.event_id.val = e.val)) := by
  by_cases h1 : p.outlier <;> by_cases h2 : p.event_id = e <;>
    simp [outlierMatch, h1, h2, u64_val_eq]

theorem timeline_find?_eq (s : Snapshot) (e : Nat) :
    (timeline s).find? (fun q => decide (q.event_id.val = e))
      = s.pdus.val.find? (fun q => !q.outlier && decide (q.event_id.val = e)) := by
  unfold timeline
  rw [List.find?_filter]
  congr 1
  funext a
  simp

theorem outlier_find?_eq (s : Snapshot) (e : Nat) :
    (s.pdus.val.filter (fun q => q.outlier)).find? (fun q => decide (q.event_id.val = e))
      = s.pdus.val.find? (fun q => q.outlier && decide (q.event_id.val = e)) := by
  rw [List.find?_filter]
  congr 1
  funext a
  simp

theorem get_pdu_ok (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) (i : Usize)
    (h : svc_timeline.get_pdu s e = ok (.Ok i)) :
    ∃ hh : i.val < s.pdus.val.length, eventOf s e.val = some (s.pdus.val[i.val]'hh) := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu at h
  rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcont⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | Ok j =>
      have hji : j = i := by
        simpa [core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] using hcont
      subst hji
      have hnon := I5hLib.post_of_ok (get_non_outlier_spec s e) hr
      simp only at hnon
      obtain ⟨hh, hfind⟩ := find?_eq_some_of_findIdx?_eq_some hnon
      refine ⟨hh, ?_⟩
      apply eventOf_eq_some_of_timeline
      rw [timeline_find?_eq, ← hfind]
      congr 1
      funext a
      rw [nonOutlierMatch_eq]
  | Err err =>
      have hnon := I5hLib.post_of_ok (get_non_outlier_spec s e) hr
      simp only at hnon
      have hnone := find?_eq_none_of_findIdx?_eq_none hnon
      have hout : svc_timeline.get_outlier s e = ok (.Ok i) := by
        simpa using hcont
      have ho := I5hLib.post_of_ok (get_outlier_spec s e) hout
      simp only at ho
      obtain ⟨hh, hfind⟩ := find?_eq_some_of_findIdx?_eq_some ho
      refine ⟨hh, ?_⟩
      apply eventOf_eq_some_of_outlier
      · rw [timeline_find?_eq, ← hnone]
        congr 1
        funext a
        rw [nonOutlierMatch_eq]
      · rw [outlier_find?_eq, ← hfind]
        congr 1
        funext a
        rw [outlierMatch_eq]


/-! ## Reading the current state snapshot -/

theorem stateEntryMatch_eq (kind : Kind) (key : U64) :
    stateEntryMatch kind key
      = (fun en : StateEntry => decide (en.kind = kind ∧ en.state_key.val = key.val)) := by
  funext en
  by_cases h1 : en.kind = kind
  · by_cases h2 : en.state_key = key
    · simp [stateEntryMatch, h1, h2]
    · have h2' : ¬ (en.state_key.val = key.val) := fun h => h2 ((I5hLib.u64_val_eq _ _).mp h)
      simp [stateEntryMatch, h1, h2, h2']
  · simp [stateEntryMatch, h1]

theorem state_get_id_ok (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) (kind : Kind) (key : U64) (id : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.state_get_id s hash kind key = ok (.Ok id)) :
    ∃ es en, stateEntries s hash.val = some es ∧
      es.find? (fun en => en.kind = kind ∧ en.state_key.val = key.val) = some en ∧
      en.event_id.val = id.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.state_get_id at h
  rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcont⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | Ok si =>
    have hfind0 := I5hLib.post_of_ok (load_full_state_spec s hash) hr
    simp only at hfind0
    obtain ⟨sh, hfind⟩ := hfind0
    rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at hcont
    obtain ⟨ss, hss, hcont2⟩ := hcont
    have hssval : ss = s.states.val[si.val] := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index] at hss
      have hh := I5hLib.post_of_ok (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec s.states si sh) hss
      simpa using hh
    have hfe := I5hLib.post_of_ok
      (find_entry_spec (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ss.entries) kind key) hcont2
    obtain ⟨en, hfind2, hev⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hfe
    rw [I5hLib.vec_deref_val] at hfind2
    rw [stateEntryMatch_eq] at hfind2
    have hes : stateEntries s hash.val = some ss.entries.val := by
      unfold stateEntries
      have hfind' : s.states.val.find? (fun x => x.hash.val = hash.val)
          = some ss := by
        simpa only [← I5hLib.u64_val_eq, ← hssval] using hfind
      rw [hfind']
      rfl
    exact ⟨ss.entries.val, en, hes, hfind2, hev⟩
  | Err e => simp at hcont

theorem state_get_ok (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) (kind : Kind) (key : U64) (i : Usize)
    (h : svc_accessor.state_get s hash kind key = ok (.Ok i)) :
    ∃ hh : i.val < s.pdus.val.length,
      stateLookup s hash.val kind key.val = some (s.pdus.val[i.val]'hh) := by
  unfold svc_accessor.state_get at h
  rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at h

theorem world_readable_now_of_room_history_visibility (s : Snapshot) (room : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.room_history_visibility s room = ok (some .WorldReadable)) :
    WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.room_history_visibility at h
  rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcont⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | Ok i =>
    obtain ⟨hsh, hroom, hget⟩ := room_state_get_ok s room Kind.HistoryVisibility 0#u64 i hr
    rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at hcont
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hcont2⟩ := hcont
    obtain ⟨hh, hlook⟩ := state_get_ok s hsh Kind.HistoryVisibility 0#u64 i hget
    rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index] at hp
    have hpv : p = s.pdus.val[i.val] := by
      have hq := I5hLib.post_of_ok (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec s.pdus i hh) hp
      simpa using hq
    have hpvis : p.history_visibility = .Is .WorldReadable := by
      cases hpvd : p.history_visibility with
      | Absent => simp [hpvd] at hcont2
      | Is v =>
        have hv : v = HistoryVisibility.WorldReadable := by simpa [hpvd] using hcont2
        rw [hv]
    refine ⟨hsh.val, hroom, s.pdus.val[i.val]'hh, hlook, ?_⟩
    rw [← hpv]
    exact hpvis
  | Err e => simp at hcont

theorem user_can_see_state_events_true (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s u room = ok true) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ Invited s u.val room.val ∨ OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∨
      WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events at h
  rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hcont⟩ := h
  cases b with
  | true => exact Or.inl (joined_of_is_joined_true s u room hb)
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hcont
    rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at hcont
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hcont⟩ := hcont
    rw [I5hLib.bind_eq_ok] at hcont
    obtain ⟨hv, hhvv, hcont⟩ := hcont
    cases o with
    | none =>
      have hvv : hv = HistoryVisibility.Shared := by simpa using hhvv.symm
      subst hv
      simp at hcont
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (once_joined_of_once_joined_true s u room hcont)))
    | some v =>
      have hvv : hv = v := by simpa using hhvv.symm
      subst hv
      cases v with
      | WorldReadable =>
        refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ?_))
        exact world_readable_now_of_room_history_visibility s room (by simpa using ho)
      | Shared =>
        simp at hcont
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (once_joined_of_once_joined_true s u room hcont)))
      | Invited =>
        simp at hcont
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl (invited_of_is_invited_true s u room hcont))
      | Joined => simp at hcont
      | Custom c => simp at hcont

theorem state_reads_need_membership (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (op : Op) (r : Reply)
    (hop : op = .State room ∨ (∃ k key, op = .StateEvent room k key) ∨ ∃ at_ m n, op = .Members room at_ m n)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, op⟩ = ok (.Ok r)) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ Invited s u.val room.val ∨ OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∨
      WorldReadableNow s room.val := by
  rcases hop with hop | hop | hop
  · subst hop
    have h' : api_state.get_state_events_route s u room = ok (.Ok r) := by
      simpa only [transition] using h
    exact user_can_see_state_events_true s u room (get_state_events_route_ok s u room r h')
  · obtain ⟨k, key, hop⟩ := hop
    subst hop
    have h' : api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s u room k key = ok (.Ok r) := by
      simpa only [transition] using h
    exact user_can_see_state_events_true s u room (get_state_events_for_key_route_ok s u room k key r h')
  · obtain ⟨at_, m, n, hop⟩ := hop
    subst hop
    have h' : api_members.get_member_events_route s u room at_ m n = ok (.Ok r) := by
      simpa only [transition] using h
    exact user_can_see_state_events_true s u room (get_member_events_route_ok s u room at_ m n r h')
